themes.title: Far-right push for 'national priority' policies
themes.blurb: Right-wing and far-right parties across Europe are intensifying their advocacy for 'national priority' policies, which prioritize citizens over immigrants in access to social services, housing, and public aid. This theme is prominently featured in Spain, Italy, France, and Norway, reflecting a shared transnational strategy to appeal to nationalist sentiments and address voter concerns over immigration and resource allocation.

countries.name: 🇪🇸 Vox
countries.note: Proposes 'national priority' in social aid, housing, and public services, restricting access for immigrants in regions like Castilla y León and Baleares.

countries.name: 🇮🇹 Fratelli d'Italia / Lega
countries.note: Supports policies that prioritize Italian citizens in public housing and social services, aligning with Vox's proposals in regional coalitions.

countries.name: 🇫🇷 Rassemblement National
countries.note: Advocates for French citizens' priority in welfare and housing, echoing similar rhetoric in Spain and Italy.

countries.name: 🇳🇴 Fremskrittspartiet
countries.note: Promotes welfare policies that prioritize Norwegian citizens, aligning with broader European far-right trends.

countries.name: 🇬🇧 Reform UK
countries.note: Criticizes immigration policies and advocates for prioritizing British citizens in social services and housing.

themes.title: Javier Milei’s declining approval amid internal strife
themes.blurb: Argentina's President Javier Milei faces growing internal divisions within his party, La Libertad Avanza, as well as declining public approval. Disputes over judicial appointments, economic policies, and leadership struggles are mirrored in international coverage, particularly in Spain, Italy, and Poland, where far-right parties are closely monitoring Milei's trajectory as a cautionary tale or a model for their own political strategies.

countries.name: 🇦🇷 La Libertad Avanza
countries.note: Internal conflicts over judicial appointments, economic policies, and leadership disputes dominate coverage, with Milei's approval ratings declining.

countries.name: 🇪🇸 Vox
countries.note: Monitors Milei's political struggles as a potential warning for far-right governance, particularly in judicial and economic reforms.

countries.name: 🇺🇸 MAGA / Trump
countries.note: Views Milei's challenges as a reflection of broader populist governance issues, with parallels drawn to Trump's own political battles.

countries.name: 🇮🇹 Fratelli d'Italia / Lega
countries.note: Analyzes Milei's economic policies and internal party conflicts as a case study for far-right governance in Europe.

countries.name: 🇵🇱 Prawo i Sprawiedliwość
countries.note: Critiques Milei's economic reforms and internal divisions, using his struggles to highlight perceived flaws in libertarian governance.

themes.title: Far-right gains in European local elections
themes.blurb: Far-right parties across Europe are making significant electoral gains in local and regional elections, reflecting a broader trend of growing support for nationalist and anti-establishment platforms. This theme is evident in Germany, Italy, Spain, and Sweden, where parties like AfD, Lega, Vox, and Sverigedemokraterna are consolidating power at the local level, often through coalitions or direct electoral victories.

countries.name: 🇩🇪 Alternative für Deutschland
countries.note: Gains in local elections, particularly in eastern Germany, with strong showings in Saxony-Anhalt and other regions.

countries.name: 🇮🇹 Fratelli d'Italia / Lega
countries.note: Increases influence in regional governments, particularly in coalitions with other right-wing parties like Vox in Spain.

countries.name: 🇪🇸 Vox
countries.note: Secures coalition agreements in Castilla y León and other regions, gaining political influence at the local level.

countries.name: 🇸🇪 Sverigedemokraterna
countries.note: Continues to grow in local elections, influencing national policies on immigration and welfare.

countries.name: 🇬🇧 Reform UK
countries.note: Makes electoral gains in local by-elections, challenging traditional parties in areas like Cumbria and Barrow.

themes.title: Internal divisions within far-right parties

countries.name: 🇬🇧 Reform UK
countries.note: Struggles with internal divisions over messaging, candidate selection, and policy direction, particularly on immigration.

countries.name: 🇫🇷 Rassemblement National
countries.note: Faces leadership tensions between Marine Le Pen and Jordan Bardella, particularly over policy direction and succession.

countries.name: 🇦🇷 La Libertad Avanza
countries.note: Internal disputes over judicial appointments, economic policies, and leadership roles dominate party dynamics.

themes.title: Far-right reactions to Middle East conflicts
themes.blurb: Far-right parties and leaders across the U.S., Argentina, Italy, Poland, and France are increasingly framing their responses to Middle East conflicts through a nationalist and often Islamophobic lens. This theme highlights how these parties are leveraging international tensions to reinforce their domestic agendas, particularly on immigration, national security, and foreign policy.

countries.name: 🇺🇸 MAGA / Trump
countries.note: Frames Middle East conflicts through a nationalist lens, emphasizing strong military responses and anti-immigration policies.

countries.name: 🇦🇷 La Libertad Avanza
countries.note: Criticizes international responses to Middle East conflicts, aligning with nationalist and anti-globalist rhetoric.

countries.name: 🇮🇹 Fratelli d'Italia / Lega
countries.note: Supports strong national security responses to Middle East conflicts, often aligning with U.S. and Israeli policies.

countries.name: 🇵🇱 Prawo i Sprawiedliwość
countries.note: Criticizes international responses to Middle East conflicts, particularly those involving Muslim-majority countries.

countries.name: 🇫🇷 Rassemblement National
countries.note: Leverages Middle East conflicts to reinforce anti-immigration and national security policies, often with Islamophobic undertones.
